findings.description: Direct inspection of V27 sit and crouch renders shows the center lap still fails to cover the raised thighs: broad shorts panels remain exposed, while overskirt fabric lifts and hangs behind/between the legs. The broader thigh-follow field does not create continuous lap coverage.

V27 front, three-quarter, and side views retain coarse triangular faceting across the skirt, uneven folded side edges, and a stiff segmented hem. The center field does not materially improve overall surface continuity.
Direct back-view inspection still cannot distinguish the rear adjustment tab and buckle from the jacket/skirt silhouette.
Authored UV mapping remains missing; no inspected view constitutes a UV layout.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V27 retained the V26 panel geometry and widened the continuous overskirt thigh-follow weight field (centerline 0.72; half/full widths 0.075/0.135 m). Direct inspection of all five views and six poses shows no adequate seated/crouched lap coverage; broad thigh areas remain exposed, and coarse faceting and hem irregularity persist. Rear-tab legibility and authored UV mapping remain unresolved. This trial does not grant fit, appearance acceptance, or release.

nextAction: REJECT V27. Stop small thigh-weight/width-only adjustments: the posed lap coverage failure persists with the shared panel field. Replace the lap panel pattern/attachment with a geometry-level continuous overlap across both raised thighs, then solve side transition and skirt surface continuity; create distinct rear tab/buckle geometry and author/verify UVs. Any new revision requires rendered five views and six poses plus direct review. Fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat execution, package and release remain unverified.
